meta.title: Bundle Packages: Moving, Clearance, Renovation | Super Umzug
meta.description: Three combined packages for home relocation, corporate moves, and landlords and property managers. Moving with renovation from one team in Munich.

hero.headline: Combined service packages for complex situations
hero.subheadline: When moving, clearance and renovation come together, we coordinate everything through one point of contact — with a clear process and one goal: the exact outcome you need, delivered.

labels.priceCtaLine: Ask our chatbot or request a callback for pricing

packages.name: Home Relocation Complete
packages.forWhom: Private households moving to a new apartment or house who want to hand over the entire move.

included.title: Consultation & planning
included.body: An on-site or video appointment, followed by a binding schedule and a clear cost framework.

included.title: Packing
included.body: Professional packing materials — or our team packs your entire household for you.

included.title: Disassembly & assembly
included.body: Wardrobes, beds and kitchens are properly dismantled and rebuilt at the destination.

included.title: Transport with our damage-free guarantee
included.body: Secured transport by trained crews — with full value compensation if anything is damaged.

included.title: Optional renovation
included.body: On request we renovate the old or the new home in part or in full — painting, flooring, bathroom and more, delivered via BayReno.

included.title: Disposal & broom-clean handover
included.body: Anything you sort out is disposed of properly and the old flat is handed over broom-clean.

packages.outcome: You spend the first night in your new home with everything already in place — no moving stress, and no arguments at the handover of your old flat.

packages.name: Corporate Move Complete
packages.forWhom: Companies relocating from one site to another — with full deposit return in mind.

included.title: Complete move-out
included.body: Furniture, equipment and archives professionally disassembled and transported.

included.title: Move-in at the new location
included.body: Setup and furnishing so operations can resume quickly.

included.title: Disposal of what's no longer needed
included.body: Anything not moving with you is disposed of or recycled properly.

included.title: Restoration of the old premises
included.body: The old space is returned to the condition agreed in your lease.

included.title: Handover
included.body: Clearing the way for full deposit return.

packages.outcome: A completed relocation with no follow-up claims from your landlord — organized by a single team.

packages.name: Full-Service for Landlords and Property Managers
packages.forWhom: Landlords, property investors and property managers who need a unit rental-ready again quickly — after a purchase or after a tenant moves out.

included.title: Complete clearance
included.body: Items left behind are removed and disposed of properly.

included.title: Damage repair
included.body: Fixing defects and damage from the previous tenancy.

included.title: Renovation to your specification
included.body: From cosmetic repairs and painting through to full refurbishment — delivered via BayReno.

included.title: Furnishing & equipping
included.body: Full furnishing on request, from kitchen to lighting.

included.title: Rental-ready handover
included.body: The unit is ready to view and ready to let.

packages.outcome: Shorter vacancy periods and a rental-ready unit — one contact for every trade, with predictable processes for recurring work.

bonus.name: Property inspection service
bonus.body: Interested in a property and want to know, before you buy, what it would cost to bring it to the condition you want? We inspect any property — entirely independently of whether you book a package afterwards or not.
includes: A joint on-site walkthrough of the property
Systematic assessment of all rooms and trades
A realistic cost estimate for your target condition
Difficulty rating per item: easy / medium / demanding
bonus.priceNote: includes the on-site appointment, condition assessment and written cost estimate
bonus.askCta: Ask more — talk to our assistant
